chunks: What (cause of conflict) is there between me and the Quraysh?
By Allāh, I have fought them when they were unbelievers and I shall fight them when they have been misled. I shall be the same for them today as I was for them yesterday!

key_terms.صَاحِبُهُمْ: their companion/associate, implying a consistent relationship or counterpart
key_terms.قُرَيْش: Quraysh, the prominent tribe of Mecca
key_terms.كَافِرِينَ: unbelievers, those in a state of kufr
key_terms.مَفْتُونِينَ: misled, those bewitched or confused in their judgment

ai.seo_question: What was Imam Ali's stance towards the Quraysh during the Battle of the Camel?
ai.summary: In this declaration preceding the Battle of the Camel, Imam Ali (AS) asserts his unwavering consistency, distinguishing between fighting the Quraysh for their initial disbelief (Kufr) and their current state of misguidance (Fitna). This statement underscores the Shia scholarly view that his rebellion was not against the tribe itself, but against the deviation from the Prophet's Sunnah, reinforcing his legitimacy as the rightful successor who remained faithful to the core tenets of Islam despite political shifts.
